description: Open a workbook in a session that the other workbook tools then use by session_id: the starting point for reading, editing, recalculating and exporting a model. Pass at most one of path, base64 (raw .xlsx or .csv bytes) or url, or none for a blank workbook (the only kind add_sheet can extend). The workbook is recalculated on load, including formulas written by other tools without cached values, so opening a file you edited elsewhere is how you read back what its formulas compute (get_outputs, get_formula_range); change inputs with set_inputs. Returns {session_id, document_id, library_file_id, sheets: [{index, name}], defined_names, calc}. For a one-off recalculation of a file, use recalc_workbook instead; to try a formula without a file, use evaluate_formula. The workbook is uploaded to the Basis API and held there for the session. Pass library_file_id instead to open a file from your Library. Each API key can hold 5 open sessions, and a session closes on its own after 30 minutes without a call. A sixth create_session fails with max_sessions and lists the open sessions; close one first. save_to_library keeps the workbook beyond the session.

iterative.description: Enable iterative calculation (Excel: Enable iterative calculation)

max_change.description: Converged once no value moves more than this (Excel default 0.001)

library_file_id.description: ID of a Library file to open (library_file_id from save_to_library or an earlier session)

path.description: Local filesystem path to an .xlsx or .csv file

url.description: Public https URL to fetch the .xlsx or .csv file from (private and local addresses are refused)
